hypothesis: This is the reference arm for checking the m2-fixed N=64 to N=128 decomposition on a second dataset. With m2 fixed at 0.5 and data_seed 1, N=64 models (seeds 20-21, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], 3000 steps, best-of-3 controls) decode force above control at about the level seen on data_seed 0 (trained force R2 0.763-0.789, force margin 0.133-0.228). All values come from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded.
expected_if_true: In both seeds, force beats its control with a margin >= 0.12, trained force R2 lies in [0.70, 0.85], the accel_step headroom-normalised margin lies in [0.60, 0.85], and val_mse_ratio < 0.05.
expected_if_false: Force margin < 0.10 or trained force R2 < 0.68 in at least one seed. That would make the m2-fixed N=64 force level depend on the dataset.
